summary: Invardia support can only work within the access your organization agreed to in the Invardia portal.

new.title: Support consent from the Invardia portal
new.text: Your install keeps the support level you set in the Invardia customer portal. A support session beyond that level is refused and recorded in Audit.

fixes.title: Environment name read correctly
fixes.text: Your install now reads its environment name from Invardia without being refused.
